title: Statistics Type
description: Essential Criteria: Identify the correct statistics describing the gas of neutrinos as Fermi-Dirac statistics.

title: Energy-Momentum Relation
description: Essential Criteria: Provide the correct relation between energy and momentum for massless neutrinos, stating that E = pc.

title: Density of States Derivation
description: Important Criteria: Show the derivation leading to the density of states per unit energy, including the correct expression for D(E).

title: Fermi Energy Expression
description: Important Criteria: Derive the expression for the highest occupied energy level at T = 0, including the correct dependence on particle density.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for common mistakes such as incorrect statistics classification or misapplication of the energy-momentum relation.
